Class BigArrayList<T>

java.lang.Object
edu.uky.cs.nil.sg.BigArrayList<T>
Type Parameters:
T - type of element stored in the list
All Implemented Interfaces:
Iterable<T>
public class BigArrayList<T> extends Object implements Iterable<T>
A custom implementation of an array list which can hold up to MAX_CAPACITY elements and which uses long integers to index elements and to measure its size().
Author:
Stephen G. Ware

    • set

      public void set(long index, T element)
      Sets the element at the given index, overwriting the element that was previous at the index, if any. If the index already exists in the list, the element at that index will be replaced and the size of the list will not change. If the index is greater than or equal to the size of the list, the list (and its size) is expanded until the index exists and then the element is placed at that index. Any other indices created because of this expansion will be set to null.
      Parameters:
      index - the index where the element should be placed
      element - the element to be placed at that index
